title: incident-bot: add contextual hints to oncall diagnostics and runbook linking
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: On-call responders frequently ask for additional context when incident-bot posts automated diagnostics and runbook links. This PR enriches oncall diagnostic messages with contextual hints derived from SLO metadata, recent related alerts, and service ownership tags so responders can triage faster.

Changes: 1) Add a lightweight contextual-hint engine in diagnostics pipeline that pulls SLO tags, last-5-alerts summary, and runbook excerpt; 2) Extend runbook card rendering to include a short actionable hint and relevant config paths; 3) Add feature flag and opt-in config per Slack workspace/team; 4) Add unit and integration tests and update docs.

Checklist:
- [x] Design review with SRE (ENG-4982)
- [x] Feature flag behind `oncall_contextual_hints`
- [x] Unit tests for hint generation
- [x] Integration test against staging Slack workspace
- [x] Backwards compatible: bots without flag continue to post existing messages

Rollout plan: enable feature flag for internal SRE team for 48h, gather feedback, then enable org-wide. Emergency kill-switch is included (env var + admin slash command).

Notes: This is a low-risk UX improvement; hints are capped to 2 lines and do not expose sensitive data (we redact KVs and secrets). Related: SUP-712 (customer reported missing context during P1), SRE-203 (observability improvements).
